metadata.description: Antevo's MCP connectors: the morning brief, markets and world risk, the weekly Tremor index, trademark registers, your own portfolio and your firm's client book.

plugins.name: the-0700-brief
plugins.description: Your agent knows the markets by 07:00: the daily brief, Market Map, Risk Radar and sector notes. Public — no account.

plugins.name: antevo-executive
plugins.description: Markets, the daily editorial read, risk radar, geopolitics and macro history. Public — no account.

plugins.name: antevo-tremor-watch
plugins.description: How many market relationships stopped behaving this week: the weekly Antevo Tremor Index, its seven families, the new breaks and every reading since 1997. Public — no account.

plugins.name: antevo-trademark
plugins.description: Screen a name or a shortlist across 50+ trademark registers, with the companies and domains already registered under each name, and the opposition window in twenty offices. Screening is public — no account; the watchlist and investigations sign you in.

plugins.name: antevo-wealth
plugins.description: Your own household — positions, allocation, AUM, drift, real assets and breaches. Signs you in over OAuth.

plugins.name: antevo-mandates
plugins.description: Your firm's client book — reviews due, meeting briefs, succession, goals and documents. Signs you in over OAuth; can record changes to your own book.
